review_scope: read-only source/API review after the three solver cases; no solver reruns

source_review.exact_binary_source_correspondence: UNKNOWN: reviewed v5.0.7 source tag, while installed wheel is 5.0.7.post1; wheel build/source identity was not proven

getEnergy_potential.finding: SolidMechanicsModel sums material.getEnergy(energy_id); MaterialCohesive::getEnergy returns values only for dissipated, reversible, and cohesive contact. Therefore cohesive reversible/contact are not also included under potential in reviewed v5.0.7 source.

getEnergy_external_work.finding: The reviewed getExternalWork computes constrained internal-force times nodal velocity and multiplies by dt for dynamic analysis; getEnergy('external work') calls it directly. No cumulative state is accumulated in this method, so the API result is per-call work increment, not the cumulative external work trace used in this experiment.
getEnergy_external_work.experiment_accounting: external_work_J in trace.csv is the independent imposed-boundary reaction/displacement estimator; native getEnergy('external work') was not sampled as the trace

insertion_traction_and_energy.finding: Reviewed v5.0.7 insertion check stores insertion_stress and current facet traction as tractions.previous; cohesive element insertion then propagates nodal state from old-node indices using CohesiveNewNodesEvent. MaterialCohesive energy is integrated from traction/opening history. This establishes source-level traction/history handling for that tag, but exact initial cohesive energy treatment and exact wheel behavior remain UNKNOWN for installed 5.0.7.post1.
insertion_traction_and_energy.installed_python_event_api: NOT_EXPORTED by api_probe.py; no public new-node parent/event/lineage symbol found

dissipated_energy_sign.finding: The experiment's raw native getEnergy('dissipated') ended negative in both loaded cases. No abs correction was made. The reviewed source/docs do not prove a root cause; this remains a native energy-contract failure for this run, not a validated negative-dissipation behavior.
dissipated_energy_sign.wheel_correspondence: Official example semantics are reference only; exact runtime/source correspondence UNKNOWN

full_debond_or_damage_state.finding: UNKNOWN. Actual cohesive damage/traction/full-failure state was not exported by the installed Python API or runner. The recorded complete_debond_step_by_dissipation_target is only an energy-target proxy and is null in both loaded cases. Insertion of eight cohesive facets does not imply fully failed or physically exposed fracture surfaces.
